# `aube access list collaborators`

- **Usage:** `aube access list collaborators <PACKAGE> [USER]`
- **Effect:** read-only

List collaborators for a package, optionally filtering to one user.

<!-- docs-navigation:start -->

Read the [workflow guide](/package-manager/publishing) for context.
[Global options](/cli/#global-flags) apply to this command too.

<!-- docs-navigation:end -->

## Arguments

- **`<PACKAGE>`** — Package name.
- **`[USER]`** — Optional user name.

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help
